criterion_fired: CRITERION 2 (Carry-forward consistency) and CRITERION 4 (Next steps specificity) and CRITERION 5 (Champion emergence escalation)
suggested_change: Add to CLAUDE.md: (1) On corrupted/incomplete call summaries, agent must flag data quality issue explicitly and reassess only readable portions rather than claiming 'no new information'; (2) Next steps must pass specificity check—'Confirm X' requires measurable outcome or question; generic verbs like 'Map' must include concrete action (e.g., 'Map: list names, titles, and stated priorities of 3+ decision stakeholders'); (3) After N consecutive calls with no champion signal, flag as deal health risk and recommend escalation language in summary; (4) ICP validation mandatory before claiming 'strong engagement'—add explicit ICP check to pre-carry-forward checklist.
